name: ai-agent-sdk-workspace
description: Private workspace orchestration for ai-agent-sdk packages

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/agent build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/a2a build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/skill-filesystem build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-http build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/protocol-anthropic-messages build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/protocol-responses build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-anthropic build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-openai build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-codex build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/auth-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-fetch build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-browser build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-node build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-otel build && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/node build && pnpm --filter ai-agent-sdk build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm --filter ai-agent-sdk typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:cli
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-package-graph.mts && node scripts/check-dependency-cruiser.mts && node scripts/check-agent-boundaries.mts && node scripts/check-runtime-boundaries.mts
scripts.check:graph: node scripts/check-package-graph.mts && node scripts/check-dependency-cruiser.mts && node scripts/check-agent-boundaries.mts
scripts.test:pack: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' check:publint && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' check:types && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 -r --filter './packages/*' test:pack
scripts.test:edge: pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/core test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/provider-http test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/mcp test:pack && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-otel test:pack
scripts.test:recovery: vitest run tests/unit/observability.spec.ts tests/unit/observability-node.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @ai-agent-sdk/observability-browser test:pack
scripts.human:basic: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --mode basic
scripts.human:deep: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --mode deep
scripts.human:hil: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --mode deep-human-in-loop
scripts.human:web: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --scenario web --force-tool
scripts.human:vision: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --scenario vision
scripts.human:image-gen: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/human.mjs --scenario image-gen --force-tool
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
